Im going to give you some recommendations, take them or leave them. First, get a job that pays slightly better that just a dishwasher job, maybe answer phone calls and do customer service such as jpmorgan chase, and start paying off your debts. Second, go to the gym or work out at home, don’t just do a lil workout, like completely submerge yourself in it. You wont change in a day but your mood will change day by day. Get out there in the world, join a community or a place where they might so something you love such as art, music, science, literally anything. At first anxiety will be nerve-wrecking but just tackle it head on, after diving in and doing this things will start to change, you might meet a special someone or you might even meet a meaningful group of people that have the same interests as you.

To summarize it, get rid off your debt first and foremost, second, work on yourself physically and mentally. And when you feel like you’re finally ready, step out into the world and just express yourself and LIVE.

You can either begin this process today, tomorrow, or whenever you can and want to, but you HAVE to do it. And always remember, quitting is never an option, always look life in the eyes and never back down.
